definition: A test on knowledge of UK life, history and institutions, generally required before Indefinite Leave to Remain (settlement) is granted, unless the applicant is exempt.
longform: The test is generally expected to be completed ahead of the settlement application itself, not as part of it. Some applicants are exempt — for example, by age — and this should be checked directly for a specific applicant rather than assumed either way.
